newsitem.title: UK: UK machine tool turnover rises 2.7% in 3m to Aug.
newsitem.headline: UK machine tool turnover rises 2.7% in 3m to Aug.

text.p: Turnover of UK machine tools rose a seasonally adjusted 2.7 percent in the three months to August compared with the previous three months and was up 5.1 percent compared with a year earlier, the Office for National Statistics said.
An 8.5 percent rise in export turnover more than offset a 0.1 per cent fall in home turnover.
Total orders in hand for machine tools at the end of August 1996 were up 4.5 percent compared with the end of May but down 9.9 percent down on August 1995.
In the three months to August, turnover of the machine tools industry averaged 203.6 million stg at current prices, an increase of 8.4 percent compared to the same period a year ago.
Total orders in hand at the end of August were estimated at 462.3 million stg, 5.0 percent lower than the level at the end of August l995.
